title: Efficient Preparation and Characterization of LDH/GCN based 3D Foam for Sustainable Continuous Column Removal of U6+and Cd2+ from Water: Mechanistic Insights and Application Feasibility
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00243E, Paper

Industrial effluents discharge uranium (U6+) and cadmium (Cd2+) into water bodies, posing serious environmental risks. We investigated using a magnesium iron layered double hydroxide intercalated with carbon nitride (LDH/g-C3N4) foam...
